title: Wide-head attention and residual-normalization feasibility campaign

acceptance_criteria.AC-WF-1: Every Campaign 7 test, profile, benchmark, candidate, review, and closure command has an immutable attempt record and the workflow validates with zero errors.
acceptance_criteria.AC-BASE-1: The Campaign 6 fingerprint, protected organizer inputs, environment, final matrix, and target profiles are verified before candidate source changes.
acceptance_criteria.AC-CORRECT-1: A retained candidate has zero failed elements with no error, OOM, unauthorized skip, or unexpected fallback in direct, model, affected-neighbor, and broader gates.
acceptance_criteria.AC-PERF-1: A retained candidate provides about five-percent reproducible target, model-profile, memory, or launch benefit and reports every material regression or storage cost.
acceptance_criteria.AC-BOUNDARY-1: New width, launch, or fusion behavior is exact-shape or proven on adjacent boundaries; unmeasured shapes retain the Campaign 6 policy.
acceptance_criteria.AC-EVIDENCE-1: Raw samples, error totals, latency, memory, backend counts, profiler events, environment, source hashes, fingerprint, and command wall time bind to the exact candidate.
acceptance_criteria.AC-REVIEW-1: Any surviving candidate receives a provenance, correctness, performance, boundary, memory, and maintainability review before integration.
acceptance_criteria.AC-RELEASE-1: Only an approved winner remains and final, organizer-default, held-out, source-derived, profile, test, documentation, workflow, graph, and tree gates are current.

roles.why: Bounds continuous optimization into measured non-repeating hypotheses
Owns isolation, sequencing, evidence lineage, integration, and stop rules
Separates true profiler ceilings from duplicated events and timing drift
Implements one exact wide-head or fused residual-normalization candidate at a time
Measures strict correctness, compilation, latency, memory, and actual backend execution
Challenges numerical safety, overfitting, memory costs, and causal claims
Issues retain, reject, plateau, or hold decisions

tasks.title: Freeze Campaign 7 scope, identity, graph context, and isolated candidate workspace
Rebaseline final matrix and exact row-6/row-8 residual profiles
Test exact row-8 head-dimension-256 Triton feasibility and launch geometries
Conditionally test exact row-6 fused residual plus LayerNorm
Retain only an approved winner and regenerate complete evidence
Reconcile source of truth, workflow, graph closure, and scoped tree

loops.finding_condition: A width-256 candidate fails compilation, direct or model correctness, boundary, timing, memory, profile, or provenance gates
loops.acceptance_condition: One exact-row route is reproducibly faster or lower-memory with zero failures, or four variants establish infeasibility or a plateau

loops.finding_condition: The fused residual-normalization candidate lacks profile authorization or fails numerical, state, timing, boundary, or provenance gates
loops.acceptance_condition: One exact-shape fusion clears the declared benefit and correctness gates, or two variants close the route
